title: PR #2: fix: resolve Genesis runtime build gate and unavailable dependency review
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

Fixes the actual GitHub gate failures from the previous release-readiness run. GenesisRuntime now constrains its network transport at the struct boundary, resolving the E0277 build error. The dependency-review workflow is removed because GitHub reports Dependency Review is unsupported when the repository Dependency Graph is unavailable; this follows the ecosystem rule to skip that gate when the capability is unavailable. Validate again on this branch before merging to main.
